fields.description: Issue includes coverage and commentary on upcoming Miami city commission elections and a poll of voters; allegations and discussion concerning Jose Aleman and immigration enforcement actions, including the transfer of an immigration inspector; extensive editorial critique of the Miami Herald’s reporting on a purported “baby-racket” adoption case and debate over adoption practices and agency control; reporting on the long-running Miami Beach public-beach access legal battle and contempt proceedings involving attorneys and a circuit judge; local public-safety and court reporting criticizing aggressive vagrancy enforcement and police conduct; notice of new Dade County contractor qualification requirements following prior exposé; Coral Gables zoning enforcement against room rentals; Miami Beach school/teacher conditions and housing; plus sports column and entertainment/nightlife advertising.
contributor: BEN F. DRUCKER, Advertising and Business Manager
